summary: Client and matter risk assessment — overall classification STANDARD RISK.

overlayBoxes.details: The client is resident in Dubai, UAE (8 years) but was classified as STANDARD RISK with only Standard customer due diligence (CDD) applied. The firm's own policy §3.2.1 explicitly states that clients resident outside the UK shall be classified as HIGH RISK and subject to Enhanced Due Diligence (deeper checks) regardless of nationality.
